masonry.description: Dress stone and raise castle walls.

metallurgy.name: Royal metallurgy
metallurgy.description: Smelt claimed ore and forge knightly arms.

logistics.name: Caravan charter
logistics.description: Expand storage and recruit road carriers.

arcana.name: Leycraft charter
arcana.description: Bind moon crystal into mana and enchanted gear.

sovereignty.name: Crown of the frontier
sovereignty.description: Found a permanent castle and house a royal workforce.

charter.name: First charter
charter.description: Open a quarry on a seam won below.

limeburning.name: Limeburning
limeburning.description: Burn lime, slake it, mix mortar.

engines.name: Engines
engines.description: Horse gins, windmills, the water hoist.

greatcrane.name: The great crane
greatcrane.description: A great crane at the wall: a double wheel and a long jib.

aqueducts.name: Aqueducts
aqueducts.description: Arcades of stone that carry water, and its power, to the works wherever they stand.

muleteers.name: Pack mules
muleteers.description: Mule trains over rough ground, where no cart road runs.

viticulture.name: Vines and wine
viticulture.description: A vineyard, a press and a cellar: the masters' wine.

rollerways.name: Rollerways
rollerways.description: Log-roller lines laid tile by tile, with splitters, gates and low trestles.

hamlet.description: Four cottages along a short road: sixteen more beds.

banker-shed.name: Banker shed
banker-shed.description: A warehouse ringed by four bankers: rough stone in, ashlar out.

lime-works.name: Lime works
lime-works.description: Clamp, kiln, slaking pit, well and mortar mill, side by side in the order of the chain.

joinery-yard.name: Joinery yard
joinery-yard.description: A sawpit, a carpenter and a clamp side by side, planks and beams running on.

ironworks.name: Ironworks
ironworks.description: A clamp, a bloomery, a forge and a smithy side by side, the iron passing from one to the next.

bakehouse.name: Bakehouse
bakehouse.description: Farm, mill, well, bakery and brewery: bread and ale from grain.
